answer: The karst bond gate makes every newcomer burn a proof-of-work nonce and lock a priced bond before its first payout: the bond is 40 units, the puzzle costs about 0.02 units per attempt, admission needs a 64-member quorum plus a 24-hour rate cap, and trust is earned only after 30 days of settled work. A ring of fake identities fails because each island of control must fund every bond separately, and a slashing priced in saffron makes a correlated burst cost more than the rewards it can extract.
